title: Recognizing the Pattern
text:
When you have $(a + b)(a - b)$, the terms with the same first part and opposite signs for the second part, this creates a special product.

The middle terms will cancel out when you expand!

title: The Identity
text:
$(a + b)(a - b) = a^2 - b^2$

This produces only two terms - the square of the first minus the square of the second.

The middle terms ($+ab$ and $-ab$) cancel each other out.

title: The Name
text:
This pattern is called the **Difference of Two Squares** (or DOTS).

$(a + b)(a - b) = a^2 - b^2$
